minor.issue: Flaky ConnectTimeout to reviens-app.preview.emergentagent.com:443 (15s timeout). Occurs sporadically on ~1-2 tests per full-suite run under load. Different test each time (test_brute_force_lockout run 2, test_cards_category_filter run 4). Infrastructure/network flake, not a code bug. Recommend either (a) increase requests timeout in tests, (b) add pytest-rerunfailures with @pytest.mark.flaky(reruns=1), or (c) target backend directly via http://localhost:8001 to avoid ingress hop.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. The fix pre-seeds login_attempts records inside the test itself (per Option C strategy).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The determinism fix is confirmed working. test_distributed_brute_force_by_ip passed 4/4 times. Any remaining flakiness in the full suite is caused by external network timeouts (ConnectTimeout to preview URL) affecting random tests, not the fix. If addressing infra flake, target the requests.Session timeout or use localhost:8001 for backend tests.
rca_of_issue: Original determinism issue: test_distributed_brute_force_by_ip attempted 30 concurrent bad logins from unique IPs to trip a >30-attempt-per-window global rate limit. Under CI load, one or more of the parallel requests could be dropped/timed out, causing counter to stay <30 and test to expect 429 that never came. Fix (Option C): pre-seed 29 fake login_attempts records directly into MongoDB, then perform a single deterministic bad login - guaranteed to cross threshold. Verification: target test now passes 4/4 consecutive full-suite runs. Any flakes seen were on unrelated tests due to external HTTPS ConnectTimeout (15s) to the preview URL - a network/ingress issue independent of this fix.
